description: The image displays three pie charts labeled "easy," "medium," and "hard," each illustrating the distribution of performance across four categories—N+K+, N−K+, N−K−, and N+K−—under the "Zero-Shot" evaluation setting. The "easy" chart shows N+K+ at 55.4% (teal), N−K+ at 38.3% (light yellow), and N+K− at 4.6% (red), with a small N−K− segment (orange) not explicitly labeled but visually present. In the "medium" chart, N+K+ accounts for 58.8% (teal), N−K+ for 35.4% (light yellow), and N+K− for 4.0% (red), with the N−K− segment again not labeled. The "hard" chart presents N+K+ at 37.3% (teal), N−K+ at 37.9% (orange), and N+K− at 6.7% (red), with the N−K− category (light yellow) appearing as a small segment not labeled in the chart but indicated in the legend. A legend on the right side of the image identifies the four categories with corresponding colors: N+K+ (teal), N−K+ (light yellow), N−K− (orange), and N+K− (red). Each pie chart includes percentage labels inside the slices, and the segments are arranged in a clockwise order starting from the top, with the largest slice generally positioned at the top-left.
